name: CP-9 Nanoshield Probe
description: The CP-9 Nanoshield Probe was a model of small probe droid used by the Chiss spy Maki'voro, a lieutenant of the spymaster known as the Shroud during the Galactic War. One of a number of probe models that Maki'voro used, the CP-9 probe was designed to shield Maki'voro and rapidly heal him.
